info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: viloqanaM kzoBaRam . ' viloqanaM parimalanam ' iti kzIrasvAmI .

examples: 'pra yaH purURi gAhate takzad vaneva SocizA (f॰1.127.4). uBayatra praSabdena nArTaH. arTopajanABAvAt.
'pravigAhyodakaM tIrRaM vanAni Palavanti ca' (rA॰6.16.2). praSabdena nArTaH. vigAhyetyavagAhyeti vAha. samAne vigAhanAvagAhane.
'asyAM nadyAM supuRyAyAM yaTezwam…avagAhyatAm' (BA0 vana0 99.33). avatIrya snAyatAm ityarTaH.
'samprApya paRqitaH kfcCraM prajYAmevAvagAhate' (rA0 3.68.53). vicAramagno Bavati, kfcCravAraRopAyaM cintayatItyAha.
'avagAQA ca pItA ca (gaNgA) punAtyA saptamaM kulam' (BA0 vana0 85.93). avagAQA praveSapUrvakaM kftasnAnA. avagAQaH pradozaH (avi0 3). avatIrRa ityarTaH.
'aByunnatA purastAdavagAQA jaGanagOravAt paScAt' (padapaNktiH) (SA0 3.8). avagAQA magnA, nyagBAvaM gatA, nyaknA.
'avagAQaM Bavatyagre viparItaM tu yozitaH.' (bf0 Slo0 saM0 9.24). ukto'rTaH.
'avagAQA dvizanto me suKI vAto'BivAti mAm' (BA0 vi0 68. 75). avagAQAH parABUtAH.
'tamopahantrIM tamasAM vagAhya' (raGu0 7.40). tamasAM nadImavagAhya tatra snAtvetyarTaH.
'eza viprEraBizwuto'po devo vigAhate' (f0 9.3.6). apaH samudraM praviSati, apsu nimajjati.
'duHKena hi vigAhyate pracakitE rAjYAM gfhaM vArDivat' (paYcata0 1.420). ukto'rTaH.
'aTAtmanaH SabdaguRaM guRajYaH padaM vimAnena vigAhamAnaH' (raGu0 13.1). vigAhamAnaH=atikrAman.
'vigAhyamAnAM sarayUM ca nOBiH' (paSyan reme) (raGu0 14.30). vigAhyamAnA=viloqyamAnA, kzoBamApAdyamAnA.
'vigAQAyAM rajanyAM ca rAjA dEnyaM paraM gataH' (BA0 droRa0 183.20). vigAQA=avatIrRA.
'vigAQe yuDi sambADe vatsyase mAm' (BA0 3.16.14). vigAQe vfdDimupeyuzi.
'iha vihArasuKaM dayitAsaKaH sarasi ko rasiko na vigAhate' (pArijAta0 10.40). vigAhate'nuBavati, aSnute, nirviSati.

'tamuvAcATa sAvitrI rajanI vyavagAhate' (BA0 vana0 297.73). vyavagAhate'vatarati. vyavayorupasargayoH Sakya ekataro hAtum. ihEvAgrime Sloke vigAQA rajanI ceyaM nivfttaSca divAkara iti SravaraRAt. tatra vigAQA'vatIrRetyevArTaH.
'duryoDano mahArAja vyavAgAhata tadbalam' (BA0 droRa0 153.11). sudUraM prAviSadityarTaH.
'viSvA uta tvayA vayaM DArA udanyA iva. ati gAhemahi dvizaH' (f0 2.7.3). atigAhemahi atikrAmema. upaplavemahi.
'aBi gotrARi sahasA gAhamAnaH' (f0 10.103.7). aBigAhamAno viloqayamAnaH, sudUramantaH praviSannityarTaH.
'pratigAhante vanAni' (rA0 3.76.34). pratigAhante'ntaH praviSanti, haWAt praviSantIti vA.
